storeUrls.title: Shopify Store URLs
storeUrls.description: One or more public Shopify store base URLs or domains (e.g. 'https://www.allbirds.com'). Failed or blocked stores emit a structured error record without stopping the rest of the batch.

storeUrl.title: Single Store URL (Legacy)
storeUrl.description: Optional legacy single Shopify store base URL. Supported for backward compatibility alongside storeUrls.

collectionHandle.title: Collection Handle Filter (Optional)
collectionHandle.description: Optional Shopify collection handle (e.g. 'mens-runners') to fetch /collections/{handle}/products.json instead of the full store catalog.

includeCollections.title: Include Store Collections (/collections.json)
includeCollections.description: When enabled, also fetches public /collections.json metadata and outputs collection discovery records alongside products.

maxPages.title: Max Pages per Store (250 products/page)
maxPages.description: Maximum number of 250-product JSON pages to fetch per store.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max Products per Store (0 = Unlimited up to Max Pages)
maxProductsPerStore.description: Optional hard cap on product records extracted per store. Set to 0 to extract all products up to maxPages * 250.

requestDelayMs.title: Polite Delay Between Requests (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Polite delay in milliseconds between paginated requests and consecutive stores. 429/503 responses automatically trigger Retry-After exponential backoff.
